episode_appearances.video_title: ABC — The Businesses and Products from Season 11, Episode 4 of Shark Tank
episode_appearances.pitch: Mail-in knife sharpening service with prepaid secure packaging.
episode_appearances.offer: Lori Greiner and Rohan Oza offered $500,000 for 20% equity; accepted on air but deal did not close.

timeline.event: Incorporated in California as Knife Aid, Inc. (entity C413196).
Pitched on Shark Tank S11E4; accepted joint Lori Greiner / Rohan Oza offer on air.
Reporting confirmed that the televised deal with Lori and Rohan did not close post-show.
Operates active mail-in knife sharpening service at knifeaid.com.

claims.text: Knife Aid, Inc. is an operating mail-in knife sharpening service incorporated in California and actively providing sharpening via knifeaid.com.
The televised handshake agreement for $500,000 for 20% equity from Lori Greiner and Rohan Oza did not close post-show.

sources.title: ABC — The Businesses and Products from Season 11, Episode 4 of Shark Tank
California Secretary of State Business Search — Knife Aid, Inc.
Food Republic — What Happened To Knife Aid After Shark Tank?

uncertainties: Current ownership breakdown following management restructuring.

episode_appearances.pitch: Plant-based, 80-calorie vegan crisps made from yuca, mushrooms, and onions.
episode_appearances.offer: Mark Cuban offered $250,000 for 5% equity plus 5% advisory shares; accepted.

timeline.event: Snacklins LLC formed in Washington, DC.
Pitched on Shark Tank S11E4; partnered with Mark Cuban for $250,000 for 5% equity plus 5% advisory shares.
Mark Cuban Companies listed Snacklins in its active investment portfolio.
Operates actively at snacklins.com and in nationwide grocery chains.

registry_records.jurisdiction: District of Columbia Department of Consumer and Regulatory Affairs

claims.text: Snacklins is an active, operating brand producing plant-based crisps distributed through national grocery stores and online at snacklins.com.
Founder Samy Kobrosly accepted Mark Cuban's investment of $250,000 for 5% equity and 5% advisory shares, and Snacklins remains an active Mark Cuban Companies portfolio entity.
